source_derived_workflow_stages.description: Determine whether Kit #4a appears applicable to the response being made.
When the application deals with children, register for Parenting after Separation and Divorce before the hearing and track the certificate.
Complete Form 13-31 and intentionally manage affidavit exhibits.
Determine whether an up-to-date Form 15-47 is required.
Select every Form 15-47 schedule required by all applicable situation rows and collect required supporting documents.
Delay signatures where instructed and swear or affirm applicable documents before an authorized witness.
Serve the other party or lawyer through a source-described method.
Use the applicable proof path, returned acknowledgment or sworn affidavit of service.
File required documents and applicable certificate subject to unresolved deadline/proof wording conflicts.
Attend the hearing or make prior arrangements to request telephone appearance and follow source-described hearing steps.
Track adjournment, reserved judgment, order, or later order-preparation work.
